_comment: Example-card locations for the settlement-change viewer. verified:false is deliberate — docs/viewer_design.md §2 requires each location be checked against the published rasters before it is presented as evidence. The settlement-change layer is not published yet, so none can be verified; these preview the layout and the driver tags (conflict / flood / arrivals / growth). Coordinates are approximate town centres. period is 'war' (2016->2018) or 'post' (2019->2023).

examples.name: Malakal
examples.caption: Town emptied during the war; the UN protection site grows alongside it.

examples.name: Leer & Mayendit
examples.caption: Repeated razing of villages across Unity State, 2015–17.

examples.name: Yei
examples.caption: Mass departure in 2016–17 as fighting reached the town.

examples.name: Wau
examples.caption: Displacement into town and camps from 2016.

examples.name: Juba
examples.caption: The capital expands through the post-agreement years — growth, not displacement.

examples.name: Bentiu
examples.caption: Protection-site growth, then severe flooding in 2021–22.

examples.name: Old Fangak (Sudd)
examples.caption: Sustained flooding along the Sudd margins from 2020.

examples.name: Renk
examples.caption: Arrivals from Sudan after 2023 — beyond the 2016–2023 data; a headline case for the model's own epochs.
examples.note: Outside current OBT range (2016–2023); shown as a placeholder for future model epochs.
